Quiz: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace Story Quiz
Question: What harm did the fire do to the three men when they came out?
OptionB: None: no hair singed, coats unchanged, and not even the smell of fire on them
OptionD: They were burned on their hands
Explanation: The fire had no power upon their bodies: no hair was singed, their coats were unchanged, and the smell of fire had not passed on them.
